newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks open slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks open slightly lower.

text.p: Wall Street stocks opened a trace lower on Friday but shrugged off a surprisingly strong September durable goods report.
The Dow industrials began down four at 5,988. The NASDAQ Index was off fractionally at 1,227, while the S&P Index fell fractionally to 702.
The long bond was down 4/32 to yield 6.86 percent.
